sources: 两语言包annual全部文本、77节点、年度设计及最新完整因果记录。仓内规则译文全文相关段落，正式PDF第3/5/6页原生提取逐条核对行动、季节、纪年、战斗，不把转写当冲突裁决源。

sections.name: 开局目标和前线准备
sections.criteria: 公开控制增长纪年目标，先军屯补牌补军，开垦产生税赋资格，再势力征召备战和留守。不是给玩家自由挑课程，也没有三种轮盘移动依次体验。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 年中收入与回合开头超限
sections.criteria: 其他席位真实推进公共轮盘触发全体年中；税赋和漕运补牌导致下一回合超过15才要求弃6，保留本场实际战术/军备。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 军备、出兵与野战占领
sections.criteria: 军备为本战炮兵服务，手牌动作与轮盘付费分别发生；来源→具体步兵/炮兵→目标→守方回应→战术→分阶段骰果→占领，回到同一纪年控制增长目标。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 西线外交与驻防
sections.criteria: 叶赫占领后改管西线：取消外喀尔喀蒙古友好不声称夺得控制，首次雇佣补强大同，新增部队与人口差形成后续耗损选择；保留手牌为新年预算服务。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 新年朝贡及防线预算
sections.criteria: 朝贡→防线维护→耗损→纪年→人物的真实次序；先说明山海关价值及破败后果，再维护/弃牌；其余防线放弃对应真实费用取舍。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 新年补给与军队整编
sections.criteria: 先以刚雇佣的大同撤旧兵示范差额，再处理叶赫大明正规军非汉人例外、朝鲜无人口和辽北超额；移除朝鲜雇佣军保留纪年费用，不误称移兵自动丢控制。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 纪年领取、新顺位与人物
sections.criteria: 占领增长兑现资格；同分旧顺位靠后优先；半手牌向上取整领取本年卡，再按接任卡顺位出人物，全部完成才公开再下一张。人物不是手牌。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

sections.name: 次年前线训练和新建目标
sections.criteria: 新公开建军条件让征兵有用途；训练原实际参战炮兵和两支步兵，再在曾开垦辽东征1兵，人口容量与税赋资格变化有前因。4次同费，用完才说明额外弃牌训练，保留最后手牌正常收尾。
sections.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

items.criteria: 对手已学动作压缩或合法开局前置，不代做学员新决策
items.verdict: 通过：内容与静态合同层

items.zh: 你执掌大明，每张纪年卡计1点威望，先得3点即可获胜。新年按下一张纪年卡的条件决定领取资格；眼前的条件是增加最多控制区域。这一年从辽北夺取叶赫部，争取第一张纪年卡。
items.en: You command Ming. Each chronology card is worth 1 prestige; the first player to reach 3 wins. At New Year, the next card determines eligibility to claim this year’s card. The revealed condition rewards the greatest increase in controlled regions. Capture Yehe from Liaobei to compete for your first card.
items.criteria: 文本先说明当前局面用途，再补当前规则/真实动作及后果；中英语义一致

items.zh: 三方共用这个行动轮盘。前进1格免费；前进2格须指定一名对手抽2张牌，前进3格则所有对手各抽2张。这次前进1格，利用开垦、军屯准备前线。
items.en: All three factions share this action wheel. Advance 1 space for free, 2 spaces by giving one chosen opponent 2 cards, or 3 spaces by giving every opponent 2 cards. Advance 1 space to prepare your frontier with Reclamation and Military Farming.
items.criteria: 文本先说明当前局面用途，再补当前规则/真实动作及后果；中英语义一致

items.zh: 要从辽北出兵，先补充当地部队和手牌。军屯：抽2张手牌，并且建立1个等级2的正规军部队。
items.en: Prepare troops and cards for an advance from Liaobei. Military Farming: draw 2 hand cards and establish 1 level-2 regular unit.

items.zh: 同格的开垦也可以执行。每个己方控制区域可增加1人口，一次最多选5处，不得超过当地人口上限。人口决定当地供养能力，也影响年中税赋。
items.en: You may also perform Reclamation in this space. Add 1 population to each of up to 5 controlled regions without exceeding their population limits. Population supports local troops and determines eligibility for midyear tax.

items.zh: 人口多于部队、且未被围城的控制区域，年中可收1张手牌。辽东现在3人口、3支部队；在这里开垦，便能取得这份收入。
items.en: At midyear, each controlled region with more population than troops and no siege provides 1 card. Liaodong currently has 3 population and 3 units. Reclaim it to qualify for that income.
items.criteria: 文本先说明当前局面用途，再补当前规则/真实动作及后果；中英语义一致

items.zh: 本回合还可执行一次手牌行动。利用刚补充的手牌征召军队，既准备进攻叶赫部，也留下部队守住辽北。 大明的征召军队：弃1张手牌，建立6个等级2部队，或2个等级4的川兵部队。选择征召军队。
items.en: You may still take one hand action this turn. Use your replenished cards to recruit troops for the attack on Yehe while retaining a garrison in Liaobei. Ming’s Raise Troops: discard 1 hand card to establish either 6 level-2 units or 2 level-4 Sichuan infantry units. Choose Raise Troops.

items.zh: 银两没有特殊效果，只能弃牌作为资源使用。用这张银两支付，保留其它牌；点击放大镜可查看整张手牌。
items.en: Silver has no special effect and is used by discarding it as a resource. Pay with this Silver card and retain your other cards. The magnifying glass opens a full-card view.

items.zh: 正规军只能在自己的本土建立。辽北是这次进攻的出发地，在这里征召。
items.en: Regular units must be established in your homeland. Recruit in Liaobei, the source of this attack.

items.zh: 这次建立6支2级部队，两支用于跨河，其余留守。等级决定每支部队的骰子：2级投八面骰，4级投十二面骰。军队超过当地人口的部分，新年须弃牌补给或减员。
items.en: Establish 6 level-2 units: send two across the river and retain the rest. Each unit’s level determines its die: level 2 uses an eight-sided die, level 4 a twelve-sided die. At New Year, troops beyond local population require cards or removal.

items.zh: 轮盘经过年中、新年时必须停留；当前玩家可择一执行格内行动，也可放弃，随后全体结算。年中每个符合税赋条件的区域收1张手牌，大明另抽5张漕运牌；刚才开垦的辽东也贡献了收入。年中还检查人物的判定条件。
items.en: The wheel must stop when passing Midyear or New Year. The active player may take one action there or decline; all factions then resolve the season. At Midyear, each tax-eligible region provides 1 card, and Ming draws 5 extra transport cards. Reclaimed Liaodong now contributes. Character judgment conditions are also checked.

items.zh: 收入带来了更多选择，但大明的手牌上限是15张，回合开始须弃掉超出的部分。保留接下来作战所需的鸳鸯阵和火炮技术，选择高亮的6张弃牌。
items.en: Income provides more options, but Ming’s hand limit is 15. Discard excess cards at the start of your turn. Retain Mandarin Duck Formation and Artillery Technology for the coming battle; discard the six highlighted cards.

items.zh: 前线兵力已经备好。前进1格到进攻调度，这回合从辽北渡河进攻叶赫部，为本年的控制增长争取优势。
items.en: Your frontier force is ready. Advance 1 space to Dispatch and Attack. Cross from Liaobei into Yehe this turn to improve your control-growth score.

items.zh: 辽北炮兵将参加这场战斗。先用本回合手牌行动研发火炮技术，再执行轮盘上的进攻。手牌行动和轮盘行动的先后由玩家决定。 军备牌打出后还需另弃1张手牌，随后留在己方场上。每张已研发的火炮技术使炮兵骰点加1，并提高炮兵可训练的等级上限。打出「火炮技术」加强炮兵。
items.en: Liaobei’s artillery will join this battle. Use your hand action to develop Artillery Technology before the wheel’s attack. You choose the order of your hand and wheel actions. Playing an armament requires discarding another hand card; the armament then remains in play. Each developed Artillery Technology adds 1 to artillery rolls and raises their training limit. Play Artillery Technology to strengthen your artillery.

items.en: The played technology is not the payment card. Discard this separate Silver card to complete development.

items.zh: 进攻调度：弃1张手牌，指挥最多6个部队移动。步兵、炮兵移动1格，骑兵移动2格；进入非己方或友好势力控制的区域触发战斗。执行调度，向叶赫部推进。
items.en: Dispatch and Attack: discard 1 card to move up to 6 units. Infantry and artillery move 1 space; cavalry move 2. Entering a region outside your control or friendship triggers combat. Dispatch your force toward Yehe.

items.en: This discard pays for the wheel action; your hand action was already used on the armament. Pay with this card and retain Mandarin Duck Formation for combat.

items.zh: 野战以存活的步兵、骑兵数量判胜负，同数时守方胜。辽北到叶赫部隔河，战场宽度为2，炮兵不占宽度。选两支2级步兵和原有的1级炮兵，再确认。
items.en: The side with more surviving infantry and cavalry wins a field battle; ties favor the defender. The river to Yehe gives a battle width of 2, while artillery ignores that width. Select two level-2 infantry and the existing level-1 artillery, then confirm.

items.en: Your force is selected. Choose Yehe as its destination. Mongol troops defend it; after you commit, the defender first decides whether to evade battle.

items.zh: 守方骑兵可撤往其它己方控制区域避战；蒙古选择迎战。每3点骰值通常造成1损伤，但它已研发骑兵铁甲，本次需要4点。接下来由双方决定是否使用战术牌。
items.en: Defending cavalry may evade into another controlled region; Mongol chooses to fight. Normally each 3 rolled points causes 1 damage, but its developed Cavalry Armor requires 4 here. Both sides may now play a tactic.

items.zh: 每场战斗通常只能打出1张战术牌。鸳鸯阵使这两支2级步兵改投十面骰，不改变部队等级；不用这张牌时，它们各投八面骰。选择并确认打出，增强这次进攻。
items.en: Normally you may play 1 tactic per battle. Mandarin Duck Formation changes these level-2 infantry to ten-sided dice without changing their levels; without it, each rolls an eight-sided die. Select and confirm the card to strengthen this attack.

items.zh: 野战依炮兵、骑兵、步兵的顺序，双方同阶段同时结算。每支参战部队掷自己的骰子；1级炮兵投六面骰。损伤先由最高等级部队承受，步骑每受1损伤降1级，降至0移除；炮兵不承伤。开始战斗，观察骰果如何改变守军。
items.en: Field battles resolve artillery, cavalry, then infantry; both sides resolve simultaneously within each phase. Each participating unit rolls its own die; level-1 artillery uses a six-sided die. Damage goes to the highest-level units first. Each damage lowers infantry or cavalry by 1 level; level 0 is removed. Artillery cannot absorb damage. Start combat and watch the rolls affect the defenders.

items.zh: 要把这次胜利计入控制区域的增长，必须留下部队占领。选择不劫掠占领，保留叶赫部人口。野战败方的人物还会获得战败标记，留待年中判定。
items.en: To turn this victory into increased control, leave troops to occupy the region. Occupy without plundering to retain Yehe’s population. The defeated side also places a defeat marker on an eligible character for midyear judgment.

items.en: Diplomacy may affect up to 3 regions adjacent to your controlled regions. Unmarked homelands, regions containing regular units, and Korea are excluded. Choose Diplomacy to deal with Mongol’s marker in Outer Khalkha.

items.en: A reverse marker means friendship while the region remains neutral; its front means vassal control. Select Outer Khalkha to remove Mongol’s reverse marker. This ends the friendship without giving Ming control.

items.en: Datong currently has only one level-1 garrison. This space also permits Hiring: discard 1 card to establish 2 level-2 mercenaries in a controlled region. Further hires in this action provide only 1 unit per card.

Maintenance, upkeep, the chronology claim, and new-year characters then resolve in order. Your spending determines the cards left for the claim.

items.en: You claimed this year’s card. The next card, whose condition was just scored, becomes current and determines order and eligible characters. The new order is Mongol, Ming, Jin. After Mongol chooses, Ming chooses. The following card is revealed only after everyone finishes.
